ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AD \parallel BE \parallel CF$, $AB=3$, $AC=9$, $DE=2$, then what is the value of $EF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AD\parallel BE\parallel CF$,\\
it follows that $\frac{AB}{BC}=\frac{DE}{EF}$,\\
Given that $AB=3$, $AC=9$, $DE=2$,\\
we have $BC=6$,\\
thus, $\frac{3}{6}=\frac{2}{EF}$,\\
therefore, $EF=\boxed{4}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three horizontal lines parallel to each other, respectively connecting points on the left oblique line and the right oblique line, labeled AD, BE, CF. On the left oblique line, from top to bottom, are A, B, C in order, and on the right oblique line, from top to bottom, are D, E, F in order. Therefore the two oblique lines are transversals, and the three horizontal lines AD, BE, CF are parallel lines. Reasoning: It is known that AB=3, AC=9, so BC=AC-AB=9-3=6. From the corresponding segments obtained by parallel lines cutting two transversals being proportional, we can get AB:BC = DE:EF. Substituting AB=3, BC=6, DE=2, we get 3:6 = 2:EF. Because 3/6 = 2/EF, therefore EF = 4.

method.method_draft: Extend the two slanted transversals in the image upward until they meet at a point P. Because AD, BE, and CF are parallel, triangles PAD, PBE, and PCF are similar. From the text, AB=3 and AC=9, so if PA=x then PB=x+3 and PC=x+9. Also DE=2, so if PD=y then PE=y+2. Similarity of triangles PAD and PBE gives PA/PB = PD/PE, so x/(x+3)=y/(y+2), hence 2x=3y. Similarity of PAD and PCF gives PA/PC = PD/PF, so x/(x+9)=y/PF, hence PF=y(x+9)/x. Substitute y=2x/3 to get PF=y+6. Since PE=y+2, EF=PF-PE=4.

再推理：延长两条斜截线向上交于 P。因为 AD、BE、CF 平行，所以三角形 PAD、PBE、PCF 相似。设 PA = x，则 PB = x + AB = x + 3，PC = x + AC = x + 9。设 PD = y，则 PE = y + DE = y + 2。由 △PAD ∼ △PBE，有 PA/PB = PD/PE，即 x/(x+3) = y/(y+2)，交叉相乘得 2x = 3y。由 △PAD ∼ △PCF，有 PA/PC = PD/PF，即 x/(x+9) = y/PF，所以 PF = y(x+9)/x。由 2x = 3y 得 y/x = 2/3，因此 PF = y + 9y/x = y + 6。又 PE = y + 2，所以 EF = PF - PE = (y + 6) - (y + 2) = 4。
